study: Capsule Review — descriptive appearance and blood-rank failure audit on previously evaluated fitting studies
freeze_role: Committed before any new quantitative appearance feature extraction in this study; previous model scores and the study-level success/failure outcomes have ALREADY been inspected. This is post-hoc failure characterization, NOT blinded preregistration.
question: Do simple prespecified image appearance measurements differ within blood-positive versus blood-negative annotated reference frames across Galar exams 25, 27 and 29, helping describe why unchanged CNN rankings vary so much?

population.role: Exactly 512 prior label-blind reference frame positions per examination, no pathology-enriched-only source positions

source.dataset: Galar v2 corrected official PNGs from original Figshare file 45258019; Le Floch et al., CC BY 4.0
source.per_image_alignment: Exact (exam,original source_frame, blood_label, reference_uniform, original_png_sha256) equality between private manifest and prior saved predictions before extracting features. Any mismatch aborts.

image_transform.source: The ORIGINAL verified PNG, EXIF-transposed and RGB-converted; preserve raw image dimensions
image_transform.padded: Pillow ImageOps.pad to 96×96, method PIL.Image.Resampling.BILINEAR, black fill, exactly as original CNN input preprocessing

predefined_appearance_features.name: mean_luminance
predefined_appearance_features.definition: mean of pixel luminance 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B /255 on 96×96 padded RGB

predefined_appearance_features.name: mean_saturation
predefined_appearance_features.definition: mean (max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B))/max(R,G,B) with zero when max channel is 0, over padded RGB

predefined_appearance_features.name: mean_positive_red_excess
predefined_appearance_features.definition: mean max(R-max(G,B),0)/255 over padded RGB; separate from historical central-crop red-excess comparator

predefined_appearance_features.name: low_luminance_fraction
predefined_appearance_features.definition: fraction of padded RGB luminance <=0.10, includes letterboxing

predefined_appearance_features.name: mean_edge_difference
predefined_appearance_features.definition: mean of horizontal and vertical absolute luminance differences on 96×96 padded RGB, normalized to [0,1]

predefined_appearance_features.name: padded_black_fraction
predefined_appearance_features.definition: fraction of 96×96 padded image pixels with all RGB channels exactly zero

reporting.unit: Individual reference-frame descriptives stratified by examination and blood label; explicitly note within-run correlation
reporting.summary: Report all eight fixed appearance features and all four fixed model scores for positive and negative reference frames in each of three exams; no feature/model selection.
reporting.private: Original images, exact frame identities, individual features/labels/scores and contact sheets remain in Capsule Review Library.
reporting.github: Only protocol, reproducibility script, synthetic tests and nonidentifying aggregate report; no raw image, per-image identity or labels.

protected_holdouts: Galar 11–20 and authors' 61–80 remain unopened. This study uses ONLY previously examined training-pool image samples from 25, 27, 29.
limits: Blood labels are source annotations, not adjudicated lesions.
No clinician has reviewed the candidate reasons for errors.
These features are not an independent diagnostic model.
Appearance differences cannot establish a causal mechanism or guarantee any augmentation will improve ranking.
Three examinations, not confirmed distinct patients; case-support 14,26,122 blood-positive images.
